items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...and Lee Collins and Cozy Cole's brother was a piano player. [INTERVIEWEE] Yea -- Teddy Cole.

ctx.x: thinking in those terms, that's common with young players today. But in those days, Tatum invented that whole thing as far as I am able to ascertain.
Oh, I agree. I remember working with Everett Barksdale with Zutty Singleton with the Three Deuces, and Lee Collins and Cozy Cole's brother was a piano player.
